decisions.statement: One kind is put up by this service, and the code beside this page names that kind.
A recipe's image is built on the cluster's buildkit rather than on this machine.
A recipe whose image the registry holds already is put up without a build.
A tick with every container recipe up to date puts nothing up, so that is no loop without end.

definition: the service putting the container recipe kind up once a commit changes what it is built from
